obligations.rule: The construction Definitions stage binds a full commitment artifact containing the exact recorded handoff hash, package binding, consumer, use, source cut and every native proposed target. Verified owner/construction review covers this whole artifact; a hash of an unrelated handoff cannot authorize another target set.

A filesystem lifecycle checkpoint is an observation, never an authority or completion proof. Every resumed stage re-observes original native/publication operations and invokes idempotent existing owners. Completion requires authenticated original receipts and current canonical view verification.

Construct ReportedHandoffResponse using the existing Define AlchLang constructor. Record it through Define ack with exact original handoff, response and message documents. Acknowledgement remains reported observation, never meaning acceptance.

Workers verify package inspection/materialization and return byte-bound observations. Global layout coverage and workspace assignments must be verified by the parent against the complete registry before deriving DirectoryFacts. No fabricated true flags inside workers.

A body scope_ref required by native record permission remains the selected native authority scope. Owning workspace and its workspace scope are explicit in the owner-reviewed custody artifact and published catalog; neither creates a semantic Project.
